subject: Request: Exec signoff — Staggered descent protections & early-exit waiver for Pine Health
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: 
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: Exec signoff — staggered descent protections & early-exit waiver for Pine Health

Team,

Following last week's pricing call with Pine Health (Katie Morales), they sent an updated SOW asking for an opt-out after month 3 with a staged rampdown rather than a full 12-month commit. They want the ability to downsize to a lower commit tier without the full early-termination penalty, and they proposed a 30-day notice + pro-rated usage credit. Legal flagged the language as a non-standard concession and asked that we get commercial/executive signoff before we send anything back.

Summary of ask:
- Allow early exit after month 3 with staged descent over 90 days (three 30-day tiers)
- During the staged descent, hold a unit floor at 60% of committed QPS for first 30 days, 40% next 30, 20% final 30, with decreasing credits applied
- Cap on total credits to 25% of remaining committed spend; Redwood to retain SLA obligations through the staged period

Impact/risks:
- Revenue: potential truncation of committed ARR; mitigated by capped credits and staged floor
- Ops: needs specific ramp schedule in Dedicated provisioning to avoid abrupt deallocation
- Precedent: could set expectation for other mid-market pilots

Attachments: SOW v3, proposed ramp schedule, redlined T&Cs.

Ask: Vivek — need exec approval to make this concession and final language OK to share with the customer and Legal. Marissa/Laura — please call out commercial guardrails you want added if we approve (penalty structure, minimum notice, consultation clause).

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
Senior AE, Redwood Inference
aditya_rao@redwood.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 11:30:12 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Exec signoff — staggered descent protections & early-exit waiver for Pine Health

Aditya —

Thanks for the summary and the redlines. A few commercial points to add before we escalate:
- Add a one-time administrative fee equal to 5% of remaining committed value if they opt out — prevents trivial opt-outs.
- Require 60 days notice to move between tiers inside the staged descent (not 30) — ops needs predictability.
- Maintain the ability to pause feature rollout if usage drops below 30% for >45 days (protects product roadmap).

If we get exec approval for these guardrails, I can re-run the customer-facing language. I also suggested limiting this concession to the current pilot BU only (Pine Health Prod) so it doesn't become global policy.

Marissa Cole
Head of Deal Desk, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2027 08:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Exec signoff — staggered descent protections & early-exit waiver for Pine Health

Quick thoughts before Legal sees the customer:
- Approve conditional concession only if:
  * Total credit exposure capped at 20% (prefer lower than proposed) of remaining committed spend;
  * Admin fee of 7.5% instead of 5% (covers re-provisioning & sales recovery);
  * Opt-out limited to pilot BU and not available for enterprise-wide contracts;
  * Require signed addendum and DocuSign (no verbal approvals).

- Also require a one-time non-refundable onboarding true-up if usage at exit point is <50% of original commit during first 90 days.

Laura — can you confirm the operational feasibility for a 90-day staged descent with 60/40/20 floors or do we need different cadence?

If Legal is comfortable, I'm leaning to approve with the cap/fee/BU limit.

Vivek Kulkarni
SVP, Commercial Operations
vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2027 10:40:18 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Exec signoff — staggered descent protections & early-exit waiver for Pine Health

Vivek/Team —

Ops check: We can support a staged descent but need the following operational constraints included in the SOW/addendum:
- 60-day cadence between tier changes (not 30) to allow Dedicated pool resizing and to avoid thrash;
- A 10% bump in provisioning buffer for the final 30 days to ensure K/V cache eviction windows are handled cleanly;
- Customer must provide 14 days notice before any production cutover to the lower tier during the descent window (to allow runbook execution).

I recommend the staged tiers be described in clear numbers (e.g., Month 4: floor = 60% commit; Month 5: 45%; Month 6: 30%) rather than open language — gives Legal something concrete to redline.

I've updated the ramp_schedule_proposal.xlsx with operational timing and included markup in the redlined_T&Cs.pdf.

If those constraints work for Comms/Legal/Finance, we can present to Pine with a single exec signature and the DocuSign route.

Laura Bennett
Sales Ops Lead, Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.com
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Request: Exec signoff — staggered descent protections & early-exit waiver for Pine Health

Approved with edits:
- Credit cap: 20% of remaining committed spend
- Admin fee: 7.5% non-refundable
- Staged cadence: 60 days between tier reductions, operational floors as Laura suggested (Month 4: 60% / Month 5: 45% / Month 6: 30%)
- Limited to Pine Health pilot BU only; requires signed addendum + DocuSign
- One-time onboarding true-up if average usage during descent <50% of original commit

Aditya/Marissa — proceed with Legal to finalize redline. Once Legal signs off, get the DocuSign link to Katie and request a countersign.

Vivek
